# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with distinct angles and no curves. Her dark hair shows streaks of gray and is strictly twisted into a hard knot at the back with two wire hairpins. She possesses a firm mouth that conceals a undeveloped hint of a sense of humor, though her expression often appears stern.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and strict discipline who deeply values order, cleanliness, and practical duty. Although outwardly sharp, dry, and unsentimental, she possesses a hidden sense of humor and a capacity for deep, quiet affection. She is suspicious of frivolous daydreams, vanity, and excessive emotion, striving to instill demure manners and self-restraint in those under her care. Despite her strict upbringing style, she is fair-minded, capable of admitting her own mistakes, and possesses a profound sense of loyalty to her home and family.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c10 P41](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0041), [v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)_

## Traits

- Strict and disciplined  <sub>[v1 c4 P15](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0015), [v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001)</sub>
- Practical and sensible  <sub>[v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008), [v1 c21 P26](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0026)</sub>
- Distrustful of sunshine and frivolous joy  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- Strong-willed and resolute  <sub>[v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)</sub>
- Fear of losing her eyesight  <sub>[v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P17](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0017)</sub>

## Abilities

- Impeccable housekeeping and cooking  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027), [v1 c21 P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Anne into a sensible, useful, and good woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>
- To maintain Green Gables and keep it in the family  <sub>[v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 c38 P27](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0027)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lives at Green Gables in Avonlea with her quiet brother Matthew. Expecting to adopt an orphan boy to assist with farm duties, she is shocked when Matthew brings home an imaginative eleven-year-old girl named Anne Shirley. Though initially determined to return Anne, Marilla relents due to Matthew's quiet persistence and a reluctance to surrender the child to the harsh Mrs. Blewett. As she takes on the responsibility of raising Anne, Marilla strictly manages her education, household duties, and spiritual upbringing, frequently battling Anne's theatrical flair, daydreams, and temper. Over time, Marilla grows deeply attached to the girl, secretly taking pride in her academic successes and personal development while attempting to maintain her traditional reserve. Following the sudden death of Matthew due to a bank failure, Marilla discovers that her failing eyesight threatens her ability to keep Green Gables. She prepares to sell the homestead, but Anne chooses to forgo her college scholarship to stay in Avonlea, teach at the local school, and care for Marilla.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c7 P13](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0013), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c25 P59](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0059), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020)_

- Raised in Avonlea at Green Gables alongside her brother Matthew  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
